item.title: Configure Extensions
item.description: This section explains how to configure extensions. In addition to configuring extensions during installation, you can also modify extension configurations on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. Attention Configuration changes are not allowed during installation, upgrade, or uninstallation. Prerequisites You should have the platform-admin role on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles.

item.title: Configure Cluster Agent
item.description: This section explains how to configure cluster Agent. In addition to configuring cluster Agent during extension installation, you can also modify cluster Agent configurations on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. Prerequisites You should have the platform-admin role on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, please refer to Users and Platform Roles. You have successfully installed an extension with cluster Agent configured.

item.title: Disable Extensions
item.description: This section explains how to disable extensions. After an extension is installed, it is automatically enabled. You can disable extensions on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. Once disabled, you can enable it again to continue using the extension in clusters, workspaces, and projects. Prerequisites You should have the platform-admin role on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, please refer to Users and Platform Roles.
